import glob, os, time
from rapidocr_onnxruntime import RapidOCR
engine=RapidOCR()
for p in sorted(glob.glob('/app/documents/*.jpg')):
    t=time.time()
    result, elapse=engine(p)
    lines=[]
    if result:
        # result items [box, text, score]
        items=[]
        for box,text,score in result:
            ys=[pt[1] for pt in box]; xs=[pt[0] for pt in box]
            items.append((sum(ys)/len(ys), min(xs), text, score))
        items.sort(key=lambda z:(z[0], z[1]))
        # group same line within 10px
        cur=[]; last=None
        for y,x,text,score in items:
            if last is None or abs(y-last)<=12:
                cur.append((x,text))
            else:
                cur.sort(); lines.append('  '.join(t for _,t in cur)); cur=[(x,text)]
            last=y if last is None else (last+y)/2
        if cur:
            cur.sort(); lines.append('  '.join(t for _,t in cur))
    out='\n'.join(lines)
    with open('ocr_output/'+os.path.basename(p)+'.txt','w') as f: f.write(out)
    print('='*90)
    print(os.path.basename(p), 'elapsed', round(time.time()-t,1))
    print(out)

from PIL import Image
